adjudication_reason: B3 identifies implied volatility in its specialized UP2DATA volatility-surface channel and documents contractual access and pricing. The public regulatory catalog does not prove the frozen per-call/per-put Ibovespa implied-volatility snapshot, matched expiry/strike and contemporaneous index. Free samples, generic VIX, dollar volatility surfaces and internally fitted IV do not prove the required repeatable free delivery. No qualifying official free packet is established.
reopen_condition: A materially new official free repeatable feed with the exact frozen call/put IV fields, complete chain metadata, contemporaneous underlying and snapshot/publication timestamps. Paid access, trial and semantic replacement do not reopen this decision.
